impact.text: When anyone calls `previewWithdraw(totalAssets, totalAssets, totalShares)`, the internal PRBMath subtraction underflows and reverts

precondition_sources.text: A realistic deposit has occurred, with minDeposit = 1e16 so virtually every real deposit produces non-round shares.
After the deposit, totalAssets is strictly greater than HALF_SLOPE * totalShares^2 by 1-2 wei.

intent_sources.text: previewWithdraw should not underflow in its internal PRBMath subtraction when totalAssets exceeds HALF_SLOPE * totalShares^2 by 1-2 wei.
